item.title: Congress approves Bill X after an eight-hour session
item.content:encoded:
Congress approved Bill X late on Tuesday after an eight-hour session in which opposition leaders tabled fourteen amendments.

The text now goes to the president, who has fifteen working days to sign or veto it.

item.title: Bill X passes with 312 votes in favour
item.content:encoded:
The final tally recorded 312 votes in favour, 148 against and 9 abstentions, the widest margin for any government bill this session.

Three governing-coalition members broke ranks and voted against.

item.title: Industry groups react to the approval of Bill X
item.content:encoded:
Industry associations welcomed the approval of Bill X, while two unions said the transition period was too short to protect existing contracts.

Economists expect the first effects to appear in the next quarter.
